Hello DDR’s (dedicated description readers)

Hasn't been too long this time, huh?! Let's see, what's happened since the last time we spoke... I got sick and lost my voice (which SUCKS because I have a LOT of stuff I need to record and I am not very patient, but it has given me a good excuse to work on my hobbies like flying and upgrading my plane, so that's been nice).

Claire turned 27 yesterday (HAPPY BIRTHDAY CLAIRE!!) We went shopping all day, then had beignets and opened presents with my family, so that was fun!

Oh yeah, and the Insane music video got taken down by Amazon! As frustrating as that was, we've actually been able to make some pretty good headway on that situation (big thanks to Viv and the SpindleHorse team for being so helpful and supportive of fan content)! I have high hopes we'll get the video back up soon, fingers crossed!

In the meantime, feel free to watch one of the many reuploads on other people's channels. That animation is far too good to be buried!!

Ok, I think that's it. Thank you all! Your love and support mean the world to us!

~Gabe

Espero que tenham gostado dessa música que eu fiz dedicada ao personagem Godzilla do Monsterverse (Rap do Godzilla).

Godzilla é o Titã Alfa do Monsterverse, um ser ancestral que existe há milhões de anos e representa o equilíbrio da natureza. Reverenciado por antigas civilizações como uma divindade, ele desperta sempre que o planeta enfrenta ameaças capazes de destruir a ordem natural. Diferente de um simples monstro, Godzilla age como uma força da natureza, enfrentando outros Titãs para manter o equilíbrio do mundo. Sua presença imponente, seu rugido inesquecível e o devastador Sopro Atômico fazem dele um dos seres mais poderosos e temidos do cinema. Ao longo do Monsterverse, Godzilla demonstra que não luta por vingança ou destruição gratuita, mas para proteger o planeta de ameaças ainda maiores, consolidando-se como o verdadeiro Rei dos Monstros.

hkDGAYtIgQY.descricao:
VICENTE FERNANDEZ — MUJERES DIVINAS

“Mujeres Divinas” es mucho más que una canción sobre el amor. Es un reconocimiento a la fortaleza, la sensibilidad y el valor de las mujeres, contado desde la voz de un hombre que, después de muchas experiencias, termina comprendiendo que ellas también aman, sufren y merecen ser entendidas.

Detrás de este clásico está la inspiración de Martín Urieta, uno de los grandes compositores de la música ranchera, quien escribió la canción con la intención de rendir homenaje a las mujeres y recordar que el desamor nunca tiene un solo responsable. En la voz de Vicente Fernández, la obra alcanzó una dimensión histórica y terminó convirtiéndose en uno de los himnos más representativos de toda su carrera y de la música mexicana. 🎺✨

Porque Habla del momento en que aprendemos a reconocer el valor de quien estuvo a nuestro lado, antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

🔔 Suscríbete para descubrir canciones con historia, sentimiento y el contexto que las convirtió en clásicos inolvidables.
👍 Dale like si esta canción también forma parte de tu historia.

KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS in cinemas worldwide with limited screenings from August 12. 
tickets now on sale at http://katseyewildheartsfilm.com/

Two-time GRAMMY®-nominated global girl group KATSEYE is coming to cinemas worldwide with a special theatrical release ahead of their third EP, WILD.

KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is a captivating journey into the group's bold new era while celebrating the fans who helped make it possible. Featuring never-before-seen footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews from the group members, the film explores the powerful bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who helped build this movement, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS reveals why this group's story is only just beginning.

From the intense pressure of Dream Academy to chart-topping viral success, audiences experience the highs, setbacks, sacrifices, and breakthrough moments that transformed KATSEYE on their path to global pop stardom. Praised by outlets including The New York Times, Vogue, Rolling Stone, and Billboard, KATSEYE has earned acclaim for their relentless dedication to their craft and electrifying live performances. As one of pop's most exciting emerging global acts, the group continues to solidify its place as a worldwide force.

From the same team that created Netflix’s POP STAR ACADEMY, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is produced by Interscope Films and Boardwalk Pictures, in partnership with HYBE X GEFFEN, and directed by Nadia Hallgren.

COCO WATA was born in one of the most beautiful way : in a moment of sharing.
During a jam session with his band and his wife Karishma, Naâman picked up his guitar and let the music flow. Little by little, a melody was born, carried by his deep love for life, nature, and the people around him. Together, they shaped this warm and uplifting song. To finish it, Naâman chose to add a verse that he had written ages ago as a young reggae lover in Jamaica. Years later, Coco Wata still flows like a river—an invitation to slow down, embrace the beauty of the present moment, and sing together. The video brings this journey to life through a blend of studio footage and rare archive images from the early days of Naâman’s musical journey, taking us back to where it all began.

CRog5frqITI.titulo: Angelo Famao, Cecè Barretta - LA NOSTRA TERRA (Official Video)
CRog5frqITI.descricao:
Ci sono collaborazioni che nascono per fare musica… e altre che nascono per raccontare un pezzo di cuore.

La Sicilia e la Calabria sono terre che ci hanno cresciuti, ispirati e insegnato a non dimenticare mai da dove veniamo. Questa canzone è il nostro modo di dire grazie, di rendergli omaggio e di far arrivare la loro bellezza ovunque.

Speriamo che, ascoltandola, possiate sentire lo stesso orgoglio e lo stesso amore che abbiamo messo in ogni parola.

Preparatevi… perché questa non è solo una canzone, è un viaggio nelle nostre terre. 🤍🌊

RSKSzVrp6E0.descricao:
Ab heute ist das Video zu „Meine Familie“ online, das wir gemeinsam mit Sammy Amara eingespielt haben. Dieser Broilers-Klassiker stammt von unserem Bonusalbum „Alles muss raus“ und macht den Auftakt zu einer Reihe von Clips, die wir in den nächsten Wochen und Monaten mit einigen unserer Gäste veröffentlichen werden.

Mit Sammy hätte es dafür kaum einen passenderen Auftakt geben können. Die Broilers, die in diesen Sommer auch live intensiv unterwegs sind, gehören seit Jahren zu unserem Freundeskreis und es ist schon seit langer Zeit eine Riesenfreude mit ihnen unter dem Dach von JKP zusammenzuarbeiten.

Erst letzte Woche hat Sammy uns auf einem der beiden Köln-Konzerte besucht und „Meine Familie“ mit uns gesungen. Über diesen Moment haben wir uns riesig gefreut – genauso wie über eure Reaktion.

Und jetzt viel Spaß mit dem Video.

Das dazugehörige Album „Trink aus, wir müssen gehen!“ + Bonusalbum „Alles muss raus!“ ist am 29.05.2026 erschienen und kann hier » https://dietotenhosen.lnk.to/trinkaus als Dreifach-Vinylalbum und Doppel-CD bestellt werden.

dYTKUe_-BLI.descricao:
Teu Amor Me Abraça | Música Cristã de Paz, Esperança e Descanso na Presença de Deus

Quando o coração encontra descanso, o amor de Deus nos envolve e renova nossa esperança. 💛 Que esta canção fortaleça sua fé, traga paz à sua alma e lembre você de que o Senhor nunca abandona aqueles que confiam n'Ele. 

Encontre a presença de Deus em momentos de incerteza. Esta meditação ajuda a restaurar a paz interior quando o dia fica nublado.

Este vídeo foi preparado para quem busca uma oração de descanso após um período de cansaço ou sobrecarga emocional. Através de uma reflexão leve e serena, exploramos como a presença de Deus pode ser sentida mesmo nos dias nublados, trazendo conforto para o coração que precisa silenciar e repousar.

Ao acompanhar este louvor calmo, você terá a oportunidade de pausar sua rotina e renovar suas energias espirituais. A proposta é oferecer um refúgio para quem sente que o coração quer descansar, permitindo que a paz interior substitua a agitação do cotidiano. Utilize este espaço para se reconectar com o que traz alívio para sua alma.

Inscreva-se para receber semanalmente reflexões de fé e paz, e comente abaixo qual tema de oração você gostaria de ouvir na próxima semana.
Se esta música falou ao seu coração,  compartilhe esta mensagem de esperança. Deus abençoe você!

GJALLARHORN
Through Nifelheim’s eternal night
A trek of fear and dread
The keeper of the well to find
The wanderer walks ahead

Dressed in grey he struggles on
Through ice and piercing wind
His weary legs drag along  
For the price at journey’s end

By the root of Yggdrasil
Sits the watcher of the well
Oden offers his appeal
But the man is not compelled

Fill the Gjallarhorn
With water from the pool
Let me drain it down
And wisdom fill my soul

The guardian of memories
Gave his head one shake
Seldom does a silent man
Make any grave mistakes

Mimr’s face was hard and stern
He would not be swayed
He didn’t move, he didn’t turn
And Oden felt dismayed

”Just one drink from your well,
One drink and I’ll be wise.
Ask of me what you will.
There must be a price!”

Fill the Gjallarhorn
With water from the pool
Let me drain it down
And wisdom fill my soul

Oden stared into Mimr’s eyes
His face could not be read
Finally he broke a smile
And then Mimr said

”For a drink from my well
Your eye is my price.”
Oden showed a steady hand
Then calmly he said
"Give me a knife.”

Fill the Gjallarhorn
With water from the pool
Let me drain it down
And wisdom fill my soul
Lift the Gjallarhorn
Drink and you’ll be wise
Wisdom comes to those
Who will sacrifice

Haunting cinemas & IMAX® worldwide Wednesday, August 26, for a limited time only. Get tickets now at https://2bigtorig.com/  

Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.

Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

2 BIG TO RIG was created to share the SKELETOUR experience with the faithful in the territories where staging the show was not logistically feasible — and is a love letter to all those who have shared the GHOST ritual.

Shot on 16mm film, GHOST has never looked or sounded better, ripping through material from the band's six albums — including 2025’s global #1 SKELETÁ as well as non-LP favorites including “Mary On A Cross,” “Kiss the Go-Goat,” and “The Future is a Foreign Land.”"

Si en tu playlist no pueden faltar éxitos de Grupo Firme, Christian Nodal, Carín León o Fuerza Regida, esta canción tiene que estar en tu rotación. Una atmósfera melancólica perfecta para quienes disfrutan de himnos de desamor como "Ya Supérame", "Botella Tras Botella" o "Que Vuelvas", con un estilo vocal inspirado en la fuerza de Eduin Caz, la banda sinaloense y el sierreño.

Cult icon SHERI MOON ZOMBIE unveils debut single and video "I Love My Robot." Limited edition picture disc vinyl featuring "I Love My Robot" on Side A and @RobZombie "Sir Lord Acid Wolfman" on Side B available for pre-order. Only 600 copies worldwide. ---

Cult icon, actress, designer, and longtime horror favorite SHERI MOON ZOMBIE expands her creative universe today with the release of her debut single and music video, "I Love My Robot." Helmed by acclaimed producer Zeuss and accompanied by a video directed by ROB ZOMBIE, the track blends retro sci-fi, playful camp, and infectious hooks into an irresistibly offbeat anthem that is unmistakably SHERI.

Equal parts tongue-in-cheek and surprisingly timely, "I Love My Robot" offers a witty take on life in an increasingly algorithm-driven world. Beneath its infectious energy and B-movie charm, the song celebrates imagination, individuality, and the simple joy of thinking for yourself. It's a playful reminder that while technology may make life easier, nothing can replace genuine creativity or human connection.

Coinciding with today's release, Nuclear Blast has launched pre-orders for an exclusive 12-inch picture disc featuring "I Love My Robot" on Side A and Rob Zombie's "Sir Lord Acid Wolfman" on Side B. Limited to just 600 copies worldwide (500 US / 100 EU), the one-time pressing is scheduled for release on October 30, making it an essential collector's item for fans of the Zombie universe.

VdGIWrh3lyM.titulo: LOTFI DOUBLE KANON : الجزائر جامي الطّيح
VdGIWrh3lyM.descricao:
هذه الأغنية إهداءٌ من القلب إلى كل من وقف في وجه النيران دفاعًا عن الجزائر.

إلى أعوان الحماية المدنية، وأفراد الجيش، وأعوان الغابات، وكل فرق التدخل والإسعاف، وإلى الشباب والمتطوعين والمدنيين الذين هبّوا من مختلف الولايات، حاملين الماء والعتاد، ومقدّمين الدعم والمساعدة والتبرعات، وكل من ساهم بكلمة طيبة أو إعلان أو مبادرة لتخفيف آثار هذه الكارثة.

هي رسالة شكر وامتنان وعرفان لكل من خاطر براحته وسلامته من أجل حماية الأرواح والغابات، وإطفاء الحرائق، والوقوف إلى جانب إخوانه في وقت الشدة.

أنتم مثالٌ للتضامن والوحدة، وبرهنتم أن الجزائر تبقى قوية بأبنائها، وأن المحن لا تزيدها إلا صلابة وتماسكًا.

نسأل الله أن يحفظ كل من ساهم في هذا الواجب الإنساني، وأن يرحم الضحايا، ويشفي المصابين، ويحفظ الجزائر من كل سوء.

"الجزائر جامي الطّيح" ليست مجرد أغنية، بل هي رسالة وفاء لكل من أثبت أن الجزائر ستبقى واقفةً وشامخة، مهما اشتدت المحن وتعاظمت الابتلاءات. المجد لكل من صنع الأمل وسط الدخان، ولكل يدٍ امتدت لتنقذ وطنًا نحبه جميعًا.

G6VyDrK8Qmo.descricao:
Amor Traicionero | Bolero Romántico de Traición y Desamor | Lucia Velvet es una historia de amor, traición y dignidad contada a través de un bolero profundamente emotivo.

Después de trece años compartiendo la misma casa, el mismo café de cada mañana y las mismas promesas, un simple recibo de hotel cambia todo para siempre. Amor Traicionero retrata el momento en que la verdad rompe el silencio y el dolor se transforma en la fuerza necesaria para volver a empezar.

Con una interpretación intensa de Lucia Velvet, esta canción fusiona la esencia del bolero romántico con la elegancia del Latin Soul Jazz, creando una experiencia llena de emoción para quienes han amado de verdad y también han aprendido a dejar ir.

Si disfrutas de los boleros románticos, las historias de amor y desamor y la música latina con letras que llegan al corazón, esta canción es para ti.

kbJB7H_LXas.titulo: 🇵🇪 Y Se Llama Perú | Munay Pacha | Himno de Amor a Nuestra Tierra | Fiestas Patrias 2026
kbJB7H_LXas.descricao:
Con inmenso orgullo presentamos "Y Se Llama Perú", una canción dedicada a la belleza, la historia y el espíritu indomable de nuestra patria. 🇵🇪
En estas Fiestas Patrias, Munay Pacha rinde homenaje a cada rincón del Perú: desde la majestuosidad de los Andes hasta la inmensidad de la Amazonía y la fuerza del mar que baña nuestra costa. Esta obra celebra nuestras raíces, nuestras tradiciones y el amor eterno por la tierra que nos vio nacer.
Cada melodía de quena, charango y requinto lleva el sentimiento de millones de peruanos dentro y fuera del país, recordándonos que, sin importar dónde estemos... nuestro corazón siempre vuelve al Perú.
❤️ ¡Feliz 28 de Julio para todos los peruanos del mundo!
🔔 Suscríbete al canal y acompaña a Munay Pacha en este viaje musical que mantiene viva nuestra identidad andina.
👍 Si esta canción tocó tu corazón, regálanos un "Me gusta", compártela con tu familia y amigos, y cuéntanos en los comentarios desde qué ciudad o país celebras el orgullo de ser peruano.
¡Que viva el Perú! 🇵🇪

Zq0HMLhaQOw.descricao:
"Michelle (Take 1)" is an early studio recording of one of Rubber Soul's most beloved songs, released ahead of The Beatles – Rubber Soul (Special Editions). This intimate first take offers a fascinating glimpse into the song's development, showcasing the band's performance before the final master was completed.

Paul McCartney's original inspiration for "Michelle" dates back to John Lennon's time at Liverpool College of Art, where Paul and George Harrison would often attend student parties. Recalling the song's origins, Paul said:

"One of John's tutors would have parties. At one of these, sitting over in the corner, there was the troubadour in a black sweater doing Jacques Brel songs. So I used to pretend to be French and I had this song that turned out later to be 'Michelle'. So that's where it all started with me having memories of this faux French song."

Recorded during a nine-hour session on 3 November 1965, Take 1 was the only complete performance to survive on the original four-track tape. Presented here without the later overdubs heard on the finished master, it reveals the song in its earliest recorded form. The tape also preserves tantalising fragments of earlier takes that had been recorded over, offering a rare glimpse into the band's creative process.

«Tren al sur» es el primer sencillo del álbum Corazones (1990) de la banda chilena Los Prisioneros, y se ha convertido en uno de los grandes himnos del pop-rock latinoamericano.Compuesta por Jorge González, la canción evoca un viaje nostálgico en tren desde Santiago hacia el sur de Chile. Más allá de describir un paisaje físico de campos y rieles, la letra funciona como una metáfora de escape frente a las presiones urbanas, el desencanto personal y las relaciones difíciles, conectando también con los recuerdos de la infancia y las raíces sencillas.

skfZBqH1NgM.titulo: Teenage Dirtbag by Wheatus - A Bardcore | Medieval Cover by Hildegard von Blingin' ft. Friar Funk
skfZBqH1NgM.descricao:
▶ This song will be out mid-August, but you can listen to my other work on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/5BSPl6yCVGvrCyKUp2peGM?si=yyY9lJHsTwq-vf4y2nv9DQ
▶ Consider supporting the channel on Patreon, where I share all my instrumentals: https://patreon.com/hildegardvonblingin

I'm thrilled to welcome my brother Friar Funk back for a feature in this cover of the Wheatus angst anthem "Teenage Dirtbag". We had a lot of fun recording in between bellowing Mordhau and Elder Scrolls lines at each other. Oh, and before anyone gets all clever in the comments, yes the iron maiden (ye old spiked sarcophagus) is mostly a myth, but you'll have to forgive the anachronism because how could I not keep that in?

As always, this music is human made. I wrote the lyrics, created the instrumental from a mix of real and sampled instruments, and we recorded the vocals in my little turret studio.

I'll provide a few notes about the language, because there are some fun words in this one.
Greenhorn: an inexperienced person/newcomer who lacks skill and knowledge.
Wagtail: An obsequious, timid person who fawns and bows like e nervous bird.
Hedgeborn: A person born of low, mean, or unknown birth. Perhaps even on the side of the road somewhere.
Blaggard: A scoundrel, a rogue, or a rascal.

The Art: I illustrated this one from scratch but looked at lots of sad peasants in manuscripts during the process.
